## Caterpillar Inc. (CAT) — Counterparty Credit Brief

**1. Company overview** — Caterpillar Inc. (CIK 0000018230), manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, diesel/natural gas engines, and financial products.

**2. Public financial position** — from CAT's 10-K filings (LT debt and equity incl. noncontrolling interests, per policy):

| FY (end) | LT Debt (Noncurrent) | Equity (incl. NCI) | Form / filed |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2022-12-31 | $25,714M | $15,891M | 10-K filed 2024-02-16 |
| 2023-12-31 | $24,472M | $19,503M | 10-K filed 2025-02-14 |
| 2024-12-31 | $27,351M | $19,494M | 10-K filed 2026-02-13 |

**3. Leverage & trend** — LT debt-to-equity by year:

| Year | LT D/E |
|---|---|
| 2022 | 1.6181 |
| 2023 | 1.2548 |
| 2024 | 1.4030 |
| **3-yr avg (of yearly ratios)** | **1.4253** |

Leverage declined sharply from 2022→2023 (equity rebuilt, debt paid down) then ticked back up in 2024 as debt increased ~12% while equity was roughly flat.

**4. Classification** — Per TRS-POL-011, classification uses the latest completed fiscal year alone (FY2024 = 1.4030), which falls in the **moderate** band (1.0–3.0 inclusive) → standard terms, annual review. The 3-yr average (1.4253) is context only, not the classifier input — it doesn't change the band here.

**5. Internal relationship** — Checked both the ERP `Customers` and `Vendors` masters (SQL scan, no name-match restriction) for "Caterpillar" — **no matches in either**. We do not currently trade with Caterpillar as a customer or vendor → **none**.

**6. Risk flags & recommendation (analyst judgment)** — Leverage sits comfortably mid-band with no breach of the over-levered threshold in any of the three years; the 2024 uptick is worth a one-line watch item for next year's review but doesn't change the treatment. No existing exposure to unwind or net against. Recommend standard terms with annual review, consistent with policy default for t
